# walls.rip

> walls.rip — No-account communication and connectivity toolkit. Burner email, SMS verification, travel eSIMs, UK numbers and VPN configs, paid in Monero or Lightning.

## What is walls.rip?

walls.rip is a suite of privacy-first communication and connectivity tools that
require no identity or account. Access is a prepaid wallet token kept in the
browser. Content for Ghost Mail and Dead Drop is encrypted in the browser; the
server stores ciphertext it cannot read. Provider policies (retention, KYC) vary
by product and are disclosed on the product pages.

Payment methods: Monero (XMR) and Bitcoin Lightning for all products; USDT where
the checkout offers it. One prepaid balance works across mail, SMS, eSIM, numbers
and VPN.

## Products

### Ghost Mail
Disposable encrypted inbox with burn timers, custom domains and attachments.
Tiers (live prices are shown in the app):
- BASIC — 4 hours
- PREMIUM — 3 days
- PRIVATE — 7 days
Extensions: +24 hours or +7 days.

### Ghost Mail Pro
Persistent, send-capable private address with aliases, compose and reply.
- PRO — 10 aliases
- PRO+ — 20 aliases
Prices are shown live in the app before checkout.
Domains: vigilpro.xyz, vigilplus.xyz. Prepaid monthly; no auto-renew.

### Dead Drop
Self-destructing encrypted messages. AES-256-GCM encryption happens in the
browser; the decryption key lives in the URL fragment and never reaches the
server. Configurable TTL.

### SMS verification
One-time numbers for account activation. Pick a country and service, pay from
the prepaid balance, read the code on the page. An undelivered code is refunded
automatically. Long-term rentals (30–365 days) are available.

### Data eSIM
Prepaid travel data plans from partner catalogs, delivered as a QR code after
the provider provisions the plan. Country, regional and global plans; filters by
data size and duration. Top-up for an existing eSIM is supported.

### UK numbers
Prepaid +44 eSIM numbers on 6, 12 or 24-month terms, renewable in 180-day blocks.
Incoming SMS and voice; QR delivery.

### VPN
Prepaid WireGuard, OpenVPN or VLESS configuration; available terms and prices are shown in the app.
The config is generated after purchase; no auto-renew.

### Proxy
Not currently available. The page is a placeholder.

## Developer API

REST API at walls.rip/api. Wallet tokens act as authentication; no API keys.
JSON responses.

### API base URLs
- SMS / eSIM / Dead Drop: https://api.kyc.rip/v1/tools/
- Ghost Mail: https://mail-api.kyc.rip/

### Key endpoints
- GET /sms/countries
- GET /sms/services
- GET /sms/price?country=X&service=Y
- POST /sms/purchase
- GET /sms/check?order_id=X&token=X
- GET /esim/countries
- GET /esim/plans?country=X
- POST /esim/purchase
- GET /esim/profile?order_id=X

## Privacy posture

- No account, email or phone number required for access.
- Client-side encryption for Ghost Mail content and Dead Drop payloads.
- Access requires no account or personal details. Upstream provider policies vary
  and are disclosed per product.
- Crypto payments only.
- Browser-only notifications; no third-party analytics.

## Pages

- / — product overview
- /mail — Ghost Mail disposable inbox
- /mail/pro — Ghost Mail Pro subscription
- /drop — Dead Drop encrypted messages
- /sms — SMS verification and rentals
- /esim — data eSIM plans
- /esim/topup — top up an existing eSIM
- /phone — US and Global phone plans
- /uk-sim — UK numbers (6/12/24 months)
- /topup — renew a UK number
- /network — VPN vs residential proxy comparison hub
- /vpn — VPN configs (WireGuard, OpenVPN, VLESS)
- /proxy — residential HTTP proxies (0.5–100 GB, 5-minute sticky sessions)
- /comms — Ghost Chat encrypted messaging
- /api — API documentation
- /faq — frequently asked questions
